Cusco · Perú

Regional Historical Museum, Casa Garcilaso

A chronicler’s house and a regional collection

Current ratingsOpening hoursView the place on the map
Nearby places

Explore

The museum occupies a house associated with the chronicler Inca Garcilaso de la Vega. The exhibits link the longer regional past to colonial Cusco. Read labels carefully to distinguish objects from the chronicler's time from material centuries older.

Planning your visit

60–90 min · Allow this time for the visit itself. Add travel, admission queues and any scheduled tour separately.

What to look for

A chronicler’s house and a regional collection

For a picture of the house, let a doorway frame the patio. For an exhibit, note its period first; the house and the object in the case may represent very different centuries.

Getting there

History and local experience

The domestic courtyard provides a fixed point while the exhibition moves between periods. Returning to it helps separate the history of the house from the chronology of the objects.

Walking route

  1. Calle Heladeros, Casa Garcilaso, Cusco
  2. From Plaza Regocijo find the museum on Calle Heladeros, enter the courtyard and follow the numbered or signed galleries.
  3. Finish by looking at the house itself from a different side of the patio.
